record.original_question: For the Denjoy-Tichy-Uitz family g_lambda with lambda in (0,1), determine the threshold functions kappa_1(lambda) and kappa_2(lambda) defined by the growth rate of the partial-quotient sums S_t(x): kappa_1(lambda) is the supremum of kappa for which lim sup S_t(x)/t < kappa forces g_lambda'(x) = +infinity, and kappa_2(lambda) is the infimum of kappa for which lim inf S_t(x)/t > kappa forces g_lambda'(x) = 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix $\lambda\in(0,1)$ and define the Denjoy–Tichy–Uitz function $g_\lambda:[0,1]\to[0,1]$ as follows. Set $I_0=[0,1]$ and partition it into two subintervals $I_0^{(0)}=[0,\lambda]$ and $I_0^{(1)}=[\lambda,1]$, of lengths $\lambda$ and $1-\lambda$. Inductively, having defined a partition of $[0,1]$ into $2^n$ closed subintervals, split each subinterval $J$ into two pieces of lengths $\lambda\,|J|$ and $(1-\lambda)|J|$ (in left-to-right order). The function $g_\lambda$ is the unique increasing homeomorphism of $[0,1]$ sending, for every $n\ge0$ and every binary string $\varepsilon_1\cdots\varepsilon_n\in\{0,1\}^n$, the $n$-th level interval whose left endpoint has dyadic expansion $0.\varepsilon_1\cdots\varepsilon_n$ to the corresponding $n$-th level subinterval in the $\lambda$-partition. (For $\lambda=1/2$, $g_\lambda$ is the identity; the construction is the standard Salem/Minkowski-style singular function in the parameter $\lambda$.)

For an irrational $x\in(0,1)$ with regular continued-fraction expansion $x=[0;a_1,a_2,a_3,\ldots]$, set
$$S_t(x)=a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_t.$$

Define
$$\kappa_1(\lambda)=\sup\Bigl\{\kappa>0\;:\;\text{for every irrational }x\in(0,1),\ \limsup_{t\to\infty}\tfrac{S_t(x)}{t}<\kappa\ \Longrightarrow\ g_\lambda'(x)=+\infty\Bigr\},$$
$$\kappa_2(\lambda)=\inf\Bigl\{\kappa>0\;:\;\text{for every irrational }x\in(0,1),\ \liminf_{t\to\infty}\tfrac{S_t(x)}{t}>\kappa\ \Longrightarrow\ g_\lambda'(x)=0\Bigr\}.$$

Determine the two threshold functions $\kappa_1(\lambda)$ and $\kappa_2(\lambda)$ explicitly for every $\lambda\in(0,1)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches indicate that the family $g_\lambda$ (Denjoy–Tichy–Uitz) has been studied chiefly for special values such as $\lambda=1/2$ (Minkowski's question mark function) and $\lambda=(3-\sqrt5)/2$. No literature located determines the threshold functions $\kappa_1(\lambda)$, $\kappa_2(\lambda)$ for general $\lambda\in(0,1)$, and the problem appears not to have been investigated.

status_evidence.title: On arithmetical nature of Tichy-Uitz's function
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the arithmetical nature of g_lambda for the special parameter lambda = (3-sqrt 5)/2; general lambda thresholds are not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Only special-parameter cases of g_lambda have been analyzed in the literature found.
